t.zh: 数存好了，要读写其中一个像素，先得说清是哪一个。工作台给图上的每一格一对坐标 (x, y)，格子旁边画着两条坐标轴。
t.en: The numbers are stored; to read or write one pixel, one must first say which. The workbench gives every cell of an image a pair of coordinates (x, y) and draws the two axes beside the grid.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：图像坐标 (x, y) 指的是哪一个像素？前两个任务对着坐标轴点出给定坐标的格子，其中一张图宽高不等；第三个任务反过来，写出高亮格子的坐标。点中或写对那一格才算对。
t.en: This level asks: which pixel do image coordinates (x, y) refer to? The first two tasks have you pick the cell at given coordinates by the axes, one of them on an image whose width and height differ; the third goes the other way and asks for the coordinates of a highlighted cell. Only the right cell counts.

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="pixel-coordinates"></wiki-ref>：原点在左上角，从 0 数起，y 向下增大，和数学课上 y 轴朝上的坐标不同。
after.en: These are <wiki-ref to="pixel-coordinates"></wiki-ref>: the origin at the top-left corner, counting from 0, y growing downwards, unlike the upward y of school geometry.

hint.zh: 先看坐标轴上 0 在哪个角，y 往哪个方向增大。
hint.en: First see which corner the axes start at, and which way y grows.

why.zh: 这是像数学课那样让 y 从最下面一行往上数：图像坐标的 y 从最上面一行往下数，(0, 1) 是左上角往下一格。
why.en: That counts y upwards from the bottom row, as in school geometry: image y counts down from the top row, so (0, 1) is one cell below the top-left corner.

brief.zh: 在这张宽高不等的图上点出 (2, 0)。
brief.en: On this image, whose width and height differ, pick (2, 0).

why.zh: y = 0 被当成了最下面一行：图像的第 0 行在最上面，(2, 0) 在右上角。
why.en: y = 0 was taken as the bottom row: an image's row 0 is at the top, so (2, 0) is the top-right cell.

brief.zh: 写出高亮像素的坐标 (x, y)。
brief.en: Write the coordinates (x, y) of the highlighted pixel.

hint.zh: x 数的是第几列，y 数的是第几行。
hint.en: x counts the column, y the row.

why.zh: x 和 y 写反了：这张图只有 3 列，x = 3 已经在图外；x 数列，y 数行。
why.en: x and y are swapped: this image has only 3 columns, so x = 3 lies outside it; x counts columns, y rows.
